caption:
A man stepped into a cage with a humanoid robot. Watch what happens to his body. 🤖🥊

Sec 0: adrenaline floods his blood
Sec 3: his heart pounds
Sec 10: punch after punch, the robot feels nothing
Sec 20: the robot kicks back
After: he says he broke his hand

And the twist at the end changes everything.

Would you step into the cage? Comment YES or NO.
Save this for the next time someone says robots can't fight.

Source: reports on the REK human vs EngineAI T800 fight, San Francisco, Sept 2026 (Fox News, Interesting Engineering).

#nexthuman #robots #humanoidrobot #ai #futuretech
first_comment: Plot twist: the robot was remote-controlled by a human pilot. Next up: why your body clock ignores the clock change this Sunday ⏰

caption:
This Sunday your clock moves back 1 hour. Your body's clock doesn't. ⏰

Hour 0: the master clock in your brain still runs on the old time
Day 1: hunger, sleep and energy hit at the wrong time
Day 2-3: morning light starts resetting you
About a week: your body clock catches up

And the twist is in your heart.

Save this for Sunday. Keep the clock change or end it? Comment below.

Source: Janszky & Ljung, New England Journal of Medicine, 2008 (Karolinska Institutet); circadian rhythm basics.

#nexthuman #clockchange #circadianrhythm #bodyclock #health
first_comment: Fun fact: the risky one is the SPRING change, when we lose an hour. Next up: how many steps your brain really needs 🚶

caption:
Forget 10,000 steps. Your brain may start thanking you at 3,000. 🧠🚶

0 steps: a toxic protein, tau, builds up faster
3,000-5,000 a day: memory decline came about 3 years later
5,000-7,500 a day: about 7 years later
10,000? The benefit leveled off way before that

Save this and check your step counter tonight.
How many steps did you do today?

Source: Harvard Aging Brain Study, Nature Medicine, Nov 2025 (Mass General Brigham).

#nexthuman #alzheimers #brainhealth #walking #longevity
first_comment: Honest note: this study shows a link, not proof that walking prevents Alzheimer's. Talk to your doctor before big changes. Next up: why astronauts come back taller 🚀

caption:
Astronauts come back from space taller. Here's what space does to your body. 🚀

Day 0: gravity lets go of you
Day 1: fluids rush to your head, your face gets puffy
Day 2: your legs get thinner ("bird legs")
Weeks: your spine discs expand, you grow taller
Landing: gravity takes it all back

Would you go to space to grow taller? YES or NO.
Save this.

Source: NASA; reports on NASA astronaut Scott Kelly after his year in space.

#nexthuman #space #astronaut #nasa #humanbody
first_comment: Bad news: the height goes away once gravity is back. Next up: the 2 threats scientists say could wipe out humanity ⚠️

caption:
Scientists just listed the threats that could end humanity. Only two could wipe us out. ⚠️

17 threats to our health, from now to 2100:
Superbugs that no antibiotic can kill
Toxic air and a heating planet
Nuclear war and the famine after it
AI in the wrong hands

The odds are low. The stakes are everything.

Which one scares you most? Comment.

Source: The Lancet Commission on 21st-century global threats to health, October 2026.

#nexthuman #ai #future #humanity #science
first_comment: The authors say the odds are low and both threats can be prevented. What would you do first? Tomorrow: more from the future of your body 🧬
